info.name: Manthan API
info.description:
Every Manthan route, ordered so the Collection Runner can run it top to bottom.

Before running: create the managing director with `uv run python scripts/create_md.py`, then set the `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` collection variables. Everything else (tokens, IDs, emails, future time slots) is filled in by the run itself, so it can be re-run as is.

Tokens: admin folders use `adminToken`, customer folders `patientToken`, the doctor folder `doctorToken`.
